title: The Deep Ghost
author: Dominic Eriksen
blurb: Jude Voss, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
